hooks.command: cp -f "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/installer.html" /c/apps/bin/installer.html && [ "$(wc -c < "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/installer.html")" = "$(wc -c < /c/apps/bin/installer.html)" ] && fd -q -g installer.html /c/apps/bin && echo '{"systemMessage":"installer.html → c:/apps/bin/installer.html 복사 완료"}' || echo '{"systemMessage":"installer.html 복사 실패 (c:/apps/bin)"}'
